_comment: B40/B54/B58 SFX map (2026-09-18 rematch). Rules in order; first match wins. If a rule has match, NAME must match; keywords only filter. Keyword-only rules (no match) fire on keyword alone. Optional srcs[] rotates by name hash. New P1/P2 ElevenLabs packs wired.
_comment0.3.128: A1: every ability on scripts/ammo.mjs AMMO_ABILITY_COSTS — the 20 class / origin / kit abilities that fire the hero's own gun — now resolves to a firearm sound. They used to fall all the way through to the default (scan-electronic.ogg), so Controlled Pair sounded like a drone scanning a door. The gun-ability rules sit ABOVE the spell block on purpose: 'Adrenaline Dump' would otherwise be caught by veil-dark's 'drain'-adjacent siblings and 'Saturation Fire' by veil-fire's 'fire'. Rule order is the whole fix; nothing below moved.

_comment0.3.133: C/D: `resolveSfx` no longer matches against the raw lang key stored in `name` (see scripts/sfx.mjs `sfxNameCandidates`) — it matches the localized name, the de-camelized key segment and the `_dsid`. That is what makes every multi-word pattern here (`breach and clear`, `lay on hands`, `read the room`, `invoke the pact`, `one shot, one kill`, `they always line up`, `glass the block`, `steady the scope`, `beat the draw`, `sense the veil`, `read the weave`, `greater heal`, `full heal`, `faith is`, `blessed light`, `called shot`, `coup de grace`, `kill confirm`, `field repair`, `field adrenal`, `nerve agent`, `advanced tactics`, `doctor is`, `summon elemental`, `summon spirit`, `right word`, `the right word`, `a word`) reachable at all — before 0.3.133 a literal space could never match a CamelCase key, so they were dead. Patterns written `x.?y` always worked. In the same pass 17 rules had their word boundaries repaired: they carried a literal `\\b` (escaped backslash + b) rather than `\b`, so those alternatives matched nothing.
_comment0.3.134: B: the eight `gear-weapon-*` rules at the top are keyed to each weapon SKU's `_dsid` (through the `gear-use-<dsid>` ability scripts/equipment-use.mjs generates), not to its printed name, so the 30 firearms renamed in 0.3.134 keep exactly the sound they had in 0.3.133 — and so does every SKU a Director renames next. They are anchored with `$` on the dsid candidate, so they can never fire on a name. F: Elemental Shaping now uses the generic cast sound instead of elemental-shaping.ogg, which is a chemical hiss.
